notes: Budgets are the `measured` figures below plus ~15% headroom, so ordinary chunk-hash churn does not fail CI. Re-measure after a real bundle-size change: `npm run build && npm run check:bundle` prints the current numbers, then update both `measured` and `budget` together (and `measuredAt`/`measuredCommit`). Entry JS counts the module entry plus any modulepreloaded chunks. At this measurement the entry chunk was ~22% generated utility manifest (src/utilities/_generated/manifest.ts), ~20% react-dom and ~17% framer-motion; the pre-refactor entry was 458 KB gzip. Entry CSS re-measured 2026-10-05 for Tailwind 4 (6714 -> 8365 B gzip: v4 emits @property registrations and color-mix fallbacks); only that figure changed.
